source_authority_policy.written_species_pdf: canonical written biological source unless superseded by a newer owner source or explicit owner decision
source_authority_policy.owner_created_labeled_concept_art: strong visual canon; may supplement or override older visual prose when owner confirms
source_authority_policy.ai_generated_art: noncanonical visual reference/inspiration unless explicitly promoted by owner
source_authority_policy.filename_or_prompt_label: non-authoritative metadata; filenames and embedded prompt wording may be wrong and must not determine Species binding when owner/source evidence conflicts
source_authority_policy.explicit_owner_decision: highest authority for the resolved visual/morphology question
source_authority_policy.conflict_rule: never broaden species canon merely to fit contradictory artwork; record and resolve conflicts explicitly

decisions.subject: Stygian
decisions.decision: Concept-art visual direction is canonical except pointed ears are not. Stygians otherwise look mostly human apart from dark/ashy skin, horns and other explicitly authorized demonic traits. Tails are canonical; horns are optional and broadly variable; wings occur sometimes.

decisions.subject: Stygian.wings
decisions.decision: Optional wings may be functional or vestigial/nonfunctional; appearance never grants flight mechanics.

decisions.subject: Vespin
decisions.decision: Canonical anatomy is four arms and two legs. Hand-drawn Vespin art is the closest visual authority, including the prominent wasp abdomen/stinger structure.

decisions.subject: Rakuuta
decisions.decision: Rakuuta are an evolution/cousin line of kobolds. IMG_20240811_115259 is the closest visual reference. They do not have horns; the swept-back structures are ears. The black facial marking is made of actual black feathers arranged roughly in a raven shape.

decisions.subject: Furashin
decisions.decision: Furashin are more mouse-related than rat-related and have tails. They have full conscious fur control over color, pattern and texture, with up to three colors simultaneously.

decisions.subject: Rog
decisions.decision: Rog have inherent porcine features in addition to the source-backed stocky/tusked morphology.

decisions.subject: Kola-Ha
decisions.decision: The hand-drawn aquatic/fishlike concept is baseline Kola-Ha anatomy. Tail and fin size/shape vary. Bioengineering Forms remain separate from baseline biology.

decisions.subject: Mythragara
decisions.decision: Normal humanoid form always retains the hyena-like head/muzzle, fur, mobile ears, digitigrade legs and tail shown by the concept direction; hybrid form is derived rather than independently authored.

decisions.subject: Traiga
decisions.decision: Canonical base plan is two arms, two legs and a tail. Winglike traits are forearm feathering/gliding structures or source-authorized adaptations, not an extra wing pair. Source-valid characters may range freely across feathered, scaled and mixed presentation where their variant permits.

decisions.subject: Arborae
decisions.decision: Use the source range 'under 5 feet to just over 6 feet'. Players author four coordinated but separately customizable seasonal appearance profiles. Woodgrain/bark visibility ranges from barely visible to strongly tree-bark-like.

decisions.subject: Suula
decisions.decision: Acquired Adaptation markers are source-owned persistent biological history and cannot be erased in the appearance editor. Active Adaptations automatically update live appearance. Hands-extended versus hands-folded-inside-claws is live/pose state, not saved identity morphology.

decisions.subject: Nekron
decisions.decision: Skeletal/Revenant, Vampiric/Sanguivore and Shardmind/Fragmentarii are distinct one-time ascension outcomes. A base Nekron may transition only once into one outcome and receives a second customization pass derived from the original appearance.

decisions.subject: ManyToms
decisions.decision: Constituent bodies are visually identical and think/act as one entity. Seventeen remains lore/source context rather than a renderer requirement to visibly place exactly seventeen figures; rendered composition should read as one cohesive collective.

decisions.subject: Orc
decisions.decision: Lower canine/tusk structures are optional in visible presentation; most Orcs do not show prominent tusks.

decisions.subject: Dwarf
decisions.decision: Beard morphology is available regardless of sex and is not hard gender-locked. Mild dimorphism generally uses optional presets/ranges rather than mandatory gender gates.

decisions.subject: Gray
decisions.decision: Canonical height is 4 to 5 feet. Grays are hairless, effectively earless, and have minimal nose structure.

decisions.subject: Toba-Madra
decisions.decision: Newer owner source supersedes the older gorilloid concept: Toba-Madra are anthropomorphic bears leaning slightly toward bear physiology, upright/humanoid in limb use, fur-covered with ursine muzzle/nose/ears and a visible bear tail. Biological fur stays broadly within natural bear ranges; cosmetic dye may use any colors and patterns.

decisions.subject: Toba-Madra.cybernetics
decisions.decision: Visible cybernetics are projections of actual installed augmentations; cosmetic tech plating remains a separate presentation-only layer.

decisions.subject: Sharr
decisions.decision: Sharr visibly include robust Neanderthal-associated facial morphology such as heavy brow, broad nose and robust facial structure.

decisions.subject: The Free
decisions.decision: The Free support an extremely broad range of humanoid android designs, not arbitrary nonhumanoid topology. Etched/presentation patterns may be player-authored; actual replacement hardware/augmentations remain mechanics-owned.

decisions.subject: Giantkin
decisions.decision: Canonical lineages are Grendelkin, Surtrborn and Daityr. Skyborn/Stoneborn/Flameborn in example NPC prose are naming errors and must not become additional appearance lineages.

decisions.subject: pixel-art-v1.views
decisions.decision: Support full-body, portrait/zoom and tactical-token views during customization. The master authoring composition is a fixed 3/4 full-body view. Users may switch views and zoom, but may not rotate the character or simulate 3D.

decisions.subject: appearance.wardrobe
decisions.decision: Customizer includes a curated presentation-only clothing/armor/weapon/gear library sufficient for visual design; it need not match inventory. Presentation items grant no mechanics. Actual equipped-item rendering remains a separate compatible-asset projection.

decisions.subject: equipment.fit
decisions.decision: Use topology-compatible visual variant metadata with explicit fallback. Do not unrestrictedly warp assets to fit unusual bodies.

decisions.subject: conflict_resolution
decisions.decision: Bring visual/body-size source contradictions to the owner for correction rather than silently preserving or resolving them.

decisions.subject: art.filename_species_binding
decisions.decision: The AI image whose filename describes a humanoid ratman ninja is Furashin reference art. Filenames and embedded prompt labels are not reliable Species authority and must not override owner/source identification.
